description: Kept the plot on the door and refused new cuts.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Said they will be paid as slowly as we are, and named Monday's Errors without a sum.
name: John Heminges

description: Said nothing while Kemp got the height, then threw the glove, and asked nothing that was granted.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Counted the two court days, and said she is keeping two dogs and feeding neither.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Stood on the hamper, roared the line twice, and took the glove.
name: Will Kemp

description: Named the two cold hours, kept the twenty pounds off his own purse, and refused the page.
name: William Shakespeare
